headline: Chinese company Kunlun Tech has released Matrix-Game 4.0, an open-source system that lets AI generate a playable game in real time on a single consumer graphics card.
score_reason: Interesting open release, but the 'world's first' and speed claims are Kunlun's own comparison.
importance_line: Game developers and researchers get open tools to try AI-rendered games on one high-end gaming card, but the 'first' claim and the speed comparisons come from Kunlun itself.
summary: BigGo Finance reports that Kunlun Tech released Matrix-Game 4.0 on 15 October 2026 as open source, saying it is the first video-generating game system to run on a single consumer graphics card, an Nvidia RTX 5090, at 480p and 60 frames a second. A normal game engine keeps track of the rules and the world while the AI model only draws the pictures, and the company says delay between a key press and the screen reacting was about 112 milliseconds in its own tests.
notes: Full text read. All performance claims are Kunlun's own.
